We will use the following identity:

$$
∇\cdot (f\,F)=f\,∇\cdot F+F\cdot ∇f
$$

First, we compute $∇\cdot F$ and $∇f.$ We get

$$
\begin{aligned}∇f & =⟨2x,4y,6z⟩, \\ ∇\cdot F & =\frac{∂}{∂x}(y\operatorname{ln}⁡z)+\frac{∂}{∂y}(z\operatorname{ln}⁡x)+\frac{∂}{∂z}(x\operatorname{ln}⁡y)=0+0+0=0.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}∇\cdot (f\,F) & =f\,∇\cdot F+F\cdot ∇f \\  & =\operatorname{ln}⁡(x+2y+3z)\cdot 0+⟨y\operatorname{ln}⁡z,z\operatorname{ln}⁡x,x\operatorname{ln}⁡y⟩\cdot ⟨2x,4y,6z⟩ \\  & =2xy\operatorname{ln}⁡z+4yz\operatorname{ln}⁡x+6xz\operatorname{ln}⁡y.\end{aligned}
$$
